sections.heading: When a Business Needs Restructuring
sections.sub: Traction Outsourcing Limited manages every dimension of a restructuring engagement, from governance and organograms through to ownership structures, shareholder matters, and statutory requirements.

entries.title: Growth Has Outpaced Your Structure
entries.text: Reporting lines, roles, and decision-making built for an earlier headcount start breaking under current growth. We rebuild the framework around where the business is now.

entries.title: Two Entities Need to Run as One Group
entries.text: Separate entities with separate histories need a shared governance register, organogram, and policy structure to actually function as a single group.

entries.title: You Are Bringing In a New Investor
entries.text: New investment often requires a cleaner ownership or holding structure. We manage the full process, from the operational rebuild to the ownership restructure, shareholder agreements, and statutory documentation.

entries.title: A Shareholder or Ownership Dispute Needs Resolving
entries.text: Disputes over shares, roles, or decision rights need both a resolution and a workable structure afterward. Traction Outsourcing Limited handles both sides so one does not undo the other.

entries.title: The Business Is Under Financial Pressure
entries.text: Where a genuine turnaround or workout plan is needed, Traction Outsourcing Limited manages the formal process alongside the operational and staffing implications, end to end.

entries.title: Nobody Can Explain the Structure Anymore
entries.text: If reporting lines exist on paper but not in practice, and no one can explain who actually decides what, that is a structure problem we solve directly.

entries.a: Corporate restructuring is a deliberate reorganisation of a business's governance, ownership, reporting lines, staffing, and operational framework to address performance problems, prepare for growth, or adapt to a change in the business environment. It goes beyond cosmetic changes to the organogram and addresses the underlying structural causes of the problems the business is experiencing.

entries.q: Does Traction Outsourcing handle the full restructuring process, including ownership and statutory matters?
entries.a: Yes. Traction Outsourcing Limited manages every dimension of a restructuring engagement, including governance, organograms, role definitions, shareholder structures, ownership changes, statutory and documentation requirements, and implementation. You have one point of contact from start to finish.

entries.q: How long does a corporate restructuring take?
entries.a: It depends on the complexity of the business and the scope of the changes needed. A focused restructuring of a single-entity business with clear goals typically takes four to eight weeks. Group restructuring involving multiple entities, ownership changes, or financial distress takes longer. Traction Outsourcing builds a project timeline at the diagnostic stage so the client knows what to expect before work begins.

entries.q: What is the difference between corporate restructuring and startup structuring?
entries.a: Startup structuring builds foundations for a new or early-stage business that does not yet have a structure in place. Corporate restructuring rebuilds or reorganises the structure of an existing business that has outgrown, broken, or needs to change what it has. The tools overlap but the starting point and the process are different.
